title: ChemDmold

sections.heading: ChemDmold
sections.text: Feed ingredients like maize, soybean, groundnut, and cottonseed are inherently vulnerable to mold growth under high moisture conditions. Elevated humidity and temperature during storage can lead to significant mycotoxin contamination, compromising both feed quality and animal safety. ChemDmold leverages our proprietary Accelerated Natural Bio Transformation (ANBioT™) Technology to neutralize existing molds and prevent future growth. Its dual-action mechanism combines bioactive copper chelates with natural ligands to dismantle mold cell functions at the molecular level. Components BioCopper with nature identical quinolinol

sections.heading: Components
sections.text: BioCopper with nature identical quinolinol Key Features Dual-Action Efficacy: Rapid inactivation of mold cells and sustained inhibition of growth. Low-Dosage Efficiency: Effective at 25g per MT.
